definitions.definition:
To stop living; to become dead; to undergo death.
  1. followed by of as an indication of direct cause; general use:

parsedExamples.example: He died of malaria.
He died from heart failure.
He died for the one he loved.
I can't believe I just died to a turret!
She died with dignity.
Will I die a happy man?

examples: He died of malaria.
He died from heart failure.
He died for the one he loved.
I can't believe I just died to a turret!
She died with dignity.
Will I die a happy man?

definitions.definition: followed by of as an indication of direct cause; general use:

parsedExamples.example: He died of malaria.

examples: He died of malaria.

definitions.definition: followed by from as an indication of direct cause; general use, though somewhat more common in the context of medicine or the sciences:

parsedExamples.example: He died from heart failure.

examples: He died from heart failure.

definitions.definition: followed by for; often expressing wider contextual motivations, though sometimes indicating direct causes:

parsedExamples.example: He died for the one he loved.

examples: He died for the one he loved.

definitions.definition: followed by with as an indication of direct cause:
followed by to as an indication of direct cause (like from):

parsedExamples.example: I can't believe I just died to a turret!

examples: I can't believe I just died to a turret!

definitions.definition: followed by with as an indication of manner:

parsedExamples.example: She died with dignity.

examples: She died with dignity.

definitions.definition: to die in a certain form.

parsedExamples.example: Will I die a happy man?

examples: Will I die a happy man?

definitions.definition: To (stop living and) undergo (a specified death).

parsedExamples.example: He died a hero's death.
They died a thousand deaths.

examples: He died a hero's death.
They died a thousand deaths.

definitions.definition: To lose or be eliminated from a game, particularly with a deathlike animation.

parsedExamples.example: Whenever my brother dies, he ragequits.

examples: Whenever my brother dies, he ragequits.

definitions.definition: To yearn intensely.

parsedExamples.example: I'm really dying to eat in that new restaurant.
I'm dying for a piss.

examples: I'm really dying to eat in that new restaurant.
I'm dying for a piss.

definitions.definition: To be or become hated or utterly ignored or cut off, as if dead.

parsedExamples.example: The day our sister eloped, she died to our mother.

examples: The day our sister eloped, she died to our mother.

definitions.definition: To become spiritually dead; to lose hope.

parsedExamples.example: He died a little inside each time she refused to speak to him.

examples: He died a little inside each time she refused to speak to him.

definitions.definition: To be mortified or shocked by a situation.

parsedExamples.example: If anyone sees me wearing this ridiculous outfit, I'll die.

examples: If anyone sees me wearing this ridiculous outfit, I'll die.

definitions.definition: To be so overcome with emotion or laughter as to be incapacitated.

parsedExamples.example: When I found out my two favorite musicians would be recording an album together, I literally planned my own funeral arrangements and died.

examples: When I found out my two favorite musicians would be recording an album together, I literally planned my own funeral arrangements and died.

definitions.definition: To stop working; to break down or otherwise lose "vitality".

parsedExamples.example: My car died in the middle of the freeway this morning.
Sorry I couldn't call you. My phone died.
My battery died and my charger was at home.

examples: My car died in the middle of the freeway this morning.
Sorry I couldn't call you. My phone died.
My battery died and my charger was at home.

definitions.definition: To abort, to terminate (as an error condition).
To expire at the end of the session of a legislature without having been brought to a vote.

parsedExamples.example: The proposed gas tax died after the powerful rural senator refused to let it out of committee.

examples: The proposed gas tax died after the powerful rural senator refused to let it out of committee.

definitions.definition: To perish; to cease to exist; to become lost or extinct.
To sink; to faint; to pine; to languish, with weakness, discouragement, love, etc.
To become indifferent; to cease to be subject.

parsedExamples.example: to die to pleasure or to sin

examples: to die to pleasure or to sin

definitions.definition: To disappear gradually in another surface, as where mouldings are lost in a sloped or curved face.
To become vapid, flat, or spiritless, as liquor.
To fail to evoke laughter from the audience.

parsedExamples.example: Then there was that time I died onstage in Montreal...

examples: Then there was that time I died onstage in Montreal...

definitions.definition: The cubical part of a pedestal; a plinth.
A device for cutting into a specified shape.
A device used to cut an external screw thread. (Internal screw threads are cut with a tap.)
A mold for forming metal or plastic objects.
An embossed device used in stamping coins and medals.
An oblong chip fractured from a semiconductor wafer engineered to perform as an independent device or integrated circuit.
Any small cubical or square body.
An isohedral polyhedron, usually a cube, with numbers or symbols on each side and thrown in games of chance.

parsedExamples.example: Most dice are six-sided.
I rolled the die and moved 2 spaces on the board.

examples: Most dice are six-sided.
I rolled the die and moved 2 spaces on the board.

definitions.definition: That which is, or might be, determined, by a throw of the die; hazard; chance.
